text.content:
Sect: Camarilla

The Ventrue are the ruling clan of the Camarilla, drawn from leaders, executives, nobles, and commanders who see authority over Kindred and kine alike as both their right and their responsibility. They are selective in their Embraces, seeking only those with proven capacity for leadership.

Disciplines: Dominate, Fortitude, Presence

Advantage: Ventrue are natural commanders, gaining bonuses when directing or rallying others, and Dominate reinforces their innate authority.

Disadvantage: Every Ventrue may only feed from a narrowly defined type of vessel of their choosing, and feeding from any other source provides little or no sustenance.

Organization: Forms the backbone of Camarilla princes and primogen across the world, with clan members expected to maintain decorum and uphold the sect's traditions.
